name: ClinVar
scope: Submitted interpretations of variants and their relationship to conditions, with review status and submitter evidence.
mapping_methods: Submitters provide HGVS; NCBI normalises and maps to GRCh37/GRCh38.

quantitative.summary: Categorical classifications and review status; no effect-size measurement.

licence.name: NCBI public domain policy; submitters may claim rights in some content (NCBI policies page)
licence.redistribution: Freely distributable with NLM acknowledgement; keep NCBI disclaimer

update_frequency: Monthly (first Thursday) and weekly (Mondays) per README.
coverage_limitations: Classification reflects submitter evidence and varies in quality
Biased to genes and conditions that are commonly tested
known_omissions: Absence from ClinVar does not mean benign

reuse_decision.rationale: Source of record for clinical classifications; Open Targets only carries a subset (EVA evidence), so the VCF is retrieved directly.

evidence_profile.biological_context: Submitter-asserted interpretations of variants for named conditions. Each submission carries its own review status, classification, condition and evidence summary; germline and other classifications are separate fields.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Aggregate classification with review status and conflicting-interpretation flags. These grade the assertion, not the underlying evidence; submissions often rest on the same upstream evidence, so agreement between submitters is not independent confirmation.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: None as structured data. A classification asserts clinical significance and does not establish mechanism; any functional evidence is in free text.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: Condition-specific clinical significance (pathogenic to benign, or uncertain significance) as named by the submitter.
evidence_profile.absence_means: A variant missing from ClinVar has not been submitted, which reflects ascertainment (tested genes, populations, laboratories) and not benignity. Uncertain significance means unresolved, not benign.

overlaps_with_sources.note: humsavar categories are curated independently from the literature; disagreement with ClinVar is information
